title: 黄昏の切符と、記憶の澱に揺れる街
author: 灯 ともしび

en.title: The Twilight Ticket and the Town Swaying in the Dregs of Memory
en.premise: Some time has passed since I sorted through my grandfather's estate, and I come across a strange 'automatic writing machine.' Possessing a clockwork heart, the machine calls itself a 'lost child' and lures me toward a town that once served as a boundary. There, in a desolate shopping district echoing the Showa era, the residues purified in the previous story have crystallized once more into a new form.

zh.title: 黄昏之票与摇曳在记忆沉淀中的街道
zh.premise: 整理完祖父的遗物后，时光悄然流逝。直到有一天，我遇见了一台奇妙的“自动书写机”。它拥有一颗机械之心，自称为“迷路的孩子”，引导我前往曾经的境界之街。在那里，前作中被净化的沉淀以另一种形式重新结晶，化作了一条保留着昭和气息的破败商店街。
